awards.description: NSF awards (grants and cooperative agreements) from the NSF Award Search API: title, awardee institution and location, PI, amounts obligated and estimated, dates, NSF directorate, division and program, abstract. Filter by keyword, institution, state, PI, program or date range.

keyword.desc: words in the title or abstract; quote a phrase, e.g. "machine learning"

awardeeName.desc: institution name or part of it

awardeeStateCode.desc: two-letter state of the awardee institution

perfStateCode.desc: two-letter state where the work is performed

pdPIName.desc: PI name (last name, or first and last)
